description: FEMA National Resilience Guidance: A Collaborative Approach to Building Resilience is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by FEMA, Federal Emergency Management Agency. The National Resilience Guidance emphasizes that strengthening resilience requires a collective approach. A resilient nation is created and sustained through thriving communities with secure and adaptable social, economic, environmental, housing, infrastructure, and institutional systems. Addressing resilience from only one perspective or through only one resilience lens will not be successful. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, High Winds, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
